positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Murphy lists responsible and affordable housing as her first priority, including mixed-use housing and land banking.
positions.excerpt: Responsible & Affordable Housing - Build creative mixed-use housing, explore land banking, include green space, and avoid over-building by taking the time to do it right.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Murphy lists parks and green spaces as a priority, proposing to secure regional funds and grants for green spaces in every neighborhood.
positions.excerpt: Parks & Greens paces - Secure regional funds and grants to create and maintain green spaces in every neighborhood.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Murphy lists thriving local businesses as a priority, proposing a citywide network of Milwaukie businesses.
positions.excerpt: Thriving Local Businesses - Build a citywide network helping Milwaukie businesses collaborate and grow customer traffic.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Murphy lists pedestrian safety as a priority, proposing to prioritize sidewalk construction through the SAFE program.
positions.excerpt: Pedestrian Safety - Prioritize sidewalk construction on connecting streets through the SAFE program.
